52 St. Aidan's Villas, Enniscorthy
3 Bedroom Semi-Detached Residence in a Prime Residential Setting May also qualify for the Vacant Homes Grant. 
Situated in the highly sought-after and well-established development of St. Aidan's Villas, this extended three-bedroom semi-detached residence offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, families, or investors seeking a property with outstanding potential in a superb location. 
Enjoying the utmost convenience, the property is within easy walking distance of a host of local amenities including primary and secondary schools, shops, Pettitt's SuperValu, cafés, and Enniscorthy town centre, making everyday living both practical and convenient.
The accommodation is bright and well-proportioned, comprising an entrance hallway, spacious living room featuring a solid fuel stove with back boiler, fitted kitchen with ample storage units, guest WC, three generous bedrooms, and main family bathroom. 
While the property would benefit from upgrading and modernisation, it presents a wonderful opportunity for the new owner to create a home tailored to their own style and requirements. The combination of its excellent layout, mature setting, and unbeatable location makes this an attractive prospect for those looking to add value. This property may qualify for the Vacant Home Grant subject to meeting all relevant criteria.

Externally, the property benefits from a private driveway providing off-street parking, side access to the rear, and a private rear garden offering plenty of space for outdoor enjoyment or future landscaping.

Key Features:
•Highly desirable mature residential development 
•Three-bedroom semi-detached family home 
•Walking distance to schools, shops, Pettitt's SuperValu and all local town amenities 
•Solid fuel stove with back boiler 
•Main family bathroom and ground floor guest WC 
•Three well-proportioned bedrooms 
•Private driveway with off-street parking 
•Side access to most private rear garden 
•Excellent opportunity to modernise and add value 
•Superb location with exceptional convenience 
This is a property that combines location, potential, and practicality, offering an ideal canvas for buyers looking to create a comfortable family home or make a sound investment in one of Enniscorthy's most established residential areas.
